projects.description: An agent skill for creating detailed, interactive isometric illustrations of real-world machines and complex systems. Generates polished SVGs with optional WebGL shaders and 3D effects.
projects.readme_excerpt:
```sh
npx skills add wheresryan22/anatomy -g
```

The CLI asks which agents to set up (Claude Code, Antigravity, OpenCode, Codex, MiniMax Code). To skip the question, add `-a claude-code`, `-a antigravity`, `-a opencode`, `-a codex`, or `-a minimax-code`.

Then, in Claude Code:

```text
/anatomy explain how a token bucket rate limiter works, interactive
```

For Antigravity, OpenCode, Codex, or MiniMax Code, target that agent: `-a antigravity`, `-a opencode`, `-a codex`, or `-a minimax-code`. Antigravity, OpenCode and MiniMax Code take the same `/anatomy` command; in Codex, type `$anatomy`.

That's it. No API keys and nothing to `npm install`: the kit uses only Node's built-in modules.
projects.readme_intro: Anatomy A Claude skill that explains an idea by building it as a real, working object.  Also runs in Antigravity, OpenCode, Codex and MiniMax Code. Crafted, interactive isometric figures with many small precise parts, in SVG, WebGL and 3D.     Quick start  · Gallery  · What it makes  · Install  · Usage  · Examples  · How it works  · Limits examples/raptor-engine , light theme, firing. The engine and stand are SVG; the plume is a WebGL shader in the same isometric camera. Ask Claude for a figure that explains a technical idea, and Anatomy has it invent a physical thing whose working *is* the concept. projects.description: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch and on your iPhone that keeps an eye on your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more. Approve from the notch or your Lock Screen.
projects.readme_intro: **A tiny friend that lives in your Mac's notch — or at the top of your screen on Windows and Linux — and keeps an eye on your AI coding agent sessions. And now on your phone too: iPhone and Android.** Approve permissions, watch your agents work, drop a file, chat with Claude — all without leaving what you're doing. Walk away from your Mac and Mochi follows you to your iPhone: Lock Screen, Dynamic Island, widgets, Siri. **New in 0.4: Coucou is a real Mac app.** Hold a key anywhere, speak, let go: your words are pasted where you type, like Wispr Flow — free, open source, and offline with Parakeet. Record your calls without a bot in the meeting and get the transcript, the summary and the to-dos. [ ](https://github.com/Louis-CFM/coucou/releases)
